name: V2X-Seq — Vehicle-Infrastructure Cooperative Sequential Dataset
description: Large-scale sequential dataset for vehicle-infrastructure cooperative perception and multi-agent trajectory forecasting, created by Tsinghua University AIR and Baidu as an extension of DAIR-V2X. Contains 95,000 frames of continuous temporal multimodal sensory sequences and 15,000 multi-agent trajectory forecasting scenarios. Features persistent cooperative 3D tracklets and HD vector map topologies to evaluate cooperative tracking, online forecasting, and communications latency.

provenance.collection_method: Sequential multimodal recording across vehicle and infrastructure sensors with continuous temporal synchronization.
provenance.curation_notes: Sequential extension and child dataset of DAIR-V2X. While utilizing the same physical Beijing testbed infrastructure corridors as DAIR-V2X, V2X-Seq provides continuous temporal sequences (95k frames vs isolated frames), persistent cooperative tracking IDs, HD lane-level vector map networks, and multi-agent trajectory forecasting scenarios (15k scenarios), justifying an independent catalog record.
